intelligence.enrichment: A mixture with more than two components requires a combination of several methods of separation. Each method removes or collects components based on one property difference, so a complex mixture is separated step by step. The learner correctly applies this rule: A mixture with more than two components requires a combination of several methods of separation. One separation method should finish any mixture if it is done carefully enough.
